propositions: The mutation gate fails with exit code 2 when a change is based on a commit predating the introduction of scripts/mutation_gate.py, because the script is absent from the checked-out patchset tree.

Sibling gates (env-var registry gate, comment hygiene gate) already implement file-existence guards that skip cleanly with explanatory messages rather than failing, but the mutation gate lacks this guard.
Changes based before the walking-skeleton commit receive a Verified -1 verdict that reflects the gate's infrastructure failure rather than the change's quality.
The mutation gate must skip with exit 0 and an explanatory message when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, matching the pattern of sibling gates.
Changes based at or after the walking-skeleton commit must continue to run the gate normally and not be silently bypassed by the guard.
